cases.name: lost-dispatch-ack
cases.given: Dispatch may have reached provider but worker loses response
cases.expected: Retain uncertain slot; no automatic resend

cases.name: client-timeout
cases.expected: Open circuit and retain slot until qualified termination

cases.name: cancel-sent
cases.given: Cancellation request sent without backend completion evidence

cases.name: coordinator-failover
cases.given: New coordinator finds occupied old-epoch call
cases.expected: Reconcile exact call; no duplicate dispatch

cases.name: window-budget
cases.expected: At most four actual calls; all consume original ten-minute/run bounds

cases.name: queue-overflow
cases.expected: Explicit overflow/degraded status without unbounded queue

cases.name: fairness
cases.expected: Eligible other cameras progress round-robin without evading shared occupied slot

cases.name: unsupported-media
cases.given: Native media rejected by qualified route
cases.expected: Stop automatic retry until capability change; fallback remains degraded

cases.name: reanalysis-race
cases.given: Two schedulers create automatic run within rolling 24h
cases.expected: At most one admitted new run; original run never reopened

cases.name: seventh-day-edge
cases.given: Reanalysis starts near publication plus seven days
cases.expected: Deadline capped at seven days; no extension

cases.name: refresh-storm
cases.expected: One pending refresh; bounded debounce with max wait; stale CAS cannot publish

cases.name: partial-run-failure
cases.given: Some validated windows succeeded before exhaustion
cases.expected: Retain partial evidence and failed/degraded execution reason; no full coverage claim

cases.name: restore-remote-call
cases.given: Restored DB predates remote call completion
cases.expected: No new dispatch until uncertain provider execution reconciled

cases.name: late-human-edit
cases.given: Human edit commits while synthesis runs
cases.expected: CAS preserves current editorial revision and invalidates obsolete output
